fixtureReconciliation.interpretation: Logical hash differs because schema evolved; projection onto historical columns matches exactly. Added user credential columns are null in this synthetic seed; observation column order differs.

algorithm.source: git ls-tree -rlz REV and git cat-file blob; working tree untouched
algorithm.tracked_totals: All tracked Git blobs, including docs/assets/lockfiles and symlink blob bytes; no gitlinks or filesystem-followed symlinks. These totals are not exclusively source code.
algorithm.code_exclusions: Top-level docs, whitepaper, licenses, screenshots; all non-code extensions except Dockerfile. JSON/YAML/TOML/assets excluded from code counts.
classification_precedence: generated: path segment generated/__generated__ or generated token in basename or next-env.d.ts; plus explicit SQLite amalgamation and companion vendored header paths
test: top-level tests/e2e, test directory names ending tests, __tests__/uitests, .test./.spec. basename, *Tests.swift
tooling: top-level scripts/tools/.github and all root-level code files
algorithm.lines: LF count plus one for a nonempty blob lacking final LF; includes blanks/comments; no parsing or semantic inference
algorithm.native_split: native/ prefix vs all remaining code as web_or_shared
algorithm.direct_runtime_dependencies: Union of root package.json dependencies and optionalDependencies names; peer/dev dependencies excluded
algorithm.runtime_lock_entries: Non-root package-lock.json packages entries with dev != true and link != true; includes optional and nested duplicate package paths, not unique package names

limits: Path/extension classification only; no complexity, cycles, reachability, executable-LOC or authoritative-operation claims.
Root-level product entrypoints/configuration are included in tooling by explicit path rule.
Generated content without declared generated path/name can remain in another category; fixtures follow enclosing test/tooling classification.
Runtime lock entries describe lock metadata, not actually installed platform packages or package bytes.
Generated includes bundled SQLite amalgamation and companion vendor header; separated from maintained product code, not a claim that all vendor/generated content is detected.

listContext.comparability: Context only: seed/schema, Next.js (historical 16.2.6) and Node/OS changed; no causal performance claim or regression budget. Same nominal cardinalities do not establish identical workload.

protocol.clientCost: JSON.parse + AES-256-GCM Node simulation for every ENC field

limitations: Two process replays per revision; four warm samples per replay. No P95, confidence interval or acceptance threshold inferred.
First sample uses fresh page and an already running/authenticated server, not an OS-cold start.
Startup methods differ (standalone server.js vs source-runtime); increase is observed but not attributed exclusively to code or startup guard.
Browser-observed AI work POST absence is not a general process/network egress attestation.
Golden checks here do not separately verify durable audit, cancellation, complete recovery, all negative cases or cross-platform qualification.
Static counts are physical lines, not complexity or executable code.
